title: Staff Data Analyst, Marketing
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

 

The ideal candidate is a self-starter and problem-solver, skilled at leveraging technology and data to deliver top-tier analytics solutions. They thrive on addressing complex business challenges and are consistently effective in making high-judgment decisions at a rapid pace, even in the face of ambiguity and uncharted scenarios. Additionally, the ideal candidate is energized by a work environment where strategy, innovation, and decision-making are intentionally distributed, where transparency, agility, and data-driven insights are highly valued, and where colleagues at all levels hold each other to exceptionally high standards to serve Quince customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with the US team to understand what exists that we need to replicate and the gaps that we need to build upon
  • Develop and maintain automated reports to track Marketing KPIs:
    • New/Returning Customers, LTV/CAC, Total vs. inc. ROAS
    • Performance Marketing Channel: Paid Social, SEM, App, Affiliates etc.
    • CRM: Customer cohort, Database health + Lifecycle stages

 

  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to identify channel inefficiencies, scaling opportunities, areas for improving MER / Total ROAS.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Performance team to deliver experimentation and incrementality studies: Geo-Lift tests, Channel Incrementality, Brand lift, MMM validation. 
  • Partner with product, engineering and CRM to deliver:
    • A data driven customer lifecycle programme including key drivers of high-value customers 
    • A/B and multivariate tests across lifecycle touchpoints that optimize revenue per visit, and Incremental LTV / Revenue
    • A multi-category approach to cross selling, identifying triggers and next best actions based on customer behaviour

 

  • Implement data quality, governance (inc. GDPR) and AI usage best practices in collaboration with the US. 
  • Be an integral part of the international team and contribute to their growth.

 

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or similar). Master’s degree is a plus. 
  • 7+ years in a data analytics/product analytics role, ideally with a focus on supply chain within an e-commerce or technology company.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BIm Mixpanel).
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.
  • Ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights, with a focus on detail, accuracy, and clarity.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data insights and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Based in Berlin / London with the ability to come into the Berlin / London office 4 days per week

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in running Geo-lift tests across Europe
  • Previous e-commerce / multi-category experience
  • Strong Performance marketing (attribution) + CRM measurement background
  • Able to translate data analysis into action through storytelling and visualization
  • Understanding of core marketing metrics and how they interact to deliver profitable growth: LTV/CAC, ROAS, MER

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

The Reality

The frontier models are converging into commodities; the engine is no longer the differentiator. The scarcity in 2026 is not the model.

We are not looking for people to fine-tune Llama on toy datasets or write "better prompts." We are building the runtime systems that turn probabilistic token generation into reliable workers that finish 50-step tasks without spiraling. We are solving the math of multi-step reliability through engineering, not wishful thinking.

What You Will Solve

You will work on the Agentic Harness, treating the LLM as a component within a larger, deterministic control system. Your research will focus on:

  • Architecting loops that survive error accumulation. You will build verification layers that force the agent to recognize its own hallucinations and self-correct.
  • You will implement systems where the agent compiles its own constraints and the harness enforces them via constrained decoding or external execution.
  • You will optimise KV-cache hit rates and design "restorable compression" strategies to prevent attention decay.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for systems thinkers who happen to know ML, not the other way around.

  • You know that a demo is not a product. You are interested in the "boring" engineering: state machines, retries, idempotency, serialisation — that actually makes agents work.
  • You are comfortable working with the raw output of the model and building robust software in Python or Rust around it.
  • You understand why dynamic tool loading destroys inference economics. You prefer deterministic guardrails over "prompting it to be nicer."
  • You are willing to read a 500-line trace of a failed agent loop to find the exact moment the context drifted. You care about the "last mile" of reliability.

title: Werkstudent Engineering (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Steuerberatung arbeitet mit strukturierten Daten, wiederkehrenden Abläufen und klaren Regeln, und kaum etwas davon ist bisher mit moderner Software neu gebaut worden. Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen und baut über den Systemen, die wir kaufen, eigene Software: eine Datenschicht über DATEV, Werkzeuge für unsere Berater und Agenten, die wiederkehrende Arbeit übernehmen. Vogel ist kein Start-up und kein Konzern: etablierte Mandanten und echte, geprüfte Daten, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Du studierst im Master Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Physik oder ein verwandtes technisches Fach, etwa an der TUM. Neben dem Studium willst du an Software arbeiten, die jemand am nächsten Tag benutzt, statt an einem Teilstück, dessen Nutzer du nie siehst. Du arbeitest breit über Daten, Backend, Oberflächen und Agenten, direkt mit Moritz Vogel und mit den ersten Engineers, die wir gerade einstellen. Du arbeitest zwei Tage pro Woche, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit gern mehr, abgestimmt auf deinen Vorlesungsplan. Wer überzeugt, steigt nach dem Master als Founding Engineer ein. Deine Verantwortung Werkzeuge für unsere Berater Du setzt dich mit Steuerberatern und Buchhaltern an echte Fälle, findest heraus, wo die Arbeit hakt, und baust daraus ein Werkzeug, das sie am nächsten Tag nutzen. Du baust Oberflächen, Dashboards und interne Werkzeuge vom ersten Prototyp bis zu etwas, das ohne dich läuft. Dein Maßstab: Ein Berater würde es vermissen, wenn es abgeschaltet wird. Daten und Integration Du baust die Datenstrecken mit, die jede Nacht Daten aus DATEV und unseren anderen Systemen in unsere eigene Datenschicht laden, von Anfang an mit Prüfungen. Du legst Kennzahlen so an, dass jede Zahl in jedem Werkzeug und jedem Bericht dasselbe bedeutet. Du hilfst, die Systeme jedes übernommenen Hauses anzubinden, ohne dass daraus jedes Mal ein eigenes Projekt wird. Agenten und Automatisierung Du baust Agenten für wiederkehrende Arbeit mit und ziehst dabei die Linie zwischen dem, was das Modell beurteilt, und dem, was fest gerechnet wird. Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Ergebnis nachvollziehbar ist: welche Version, welche Quelle, welche Entscheidung. Du prüfst gegen abgeschlossene, geprüfte Fälle statt gegen Testdaten. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast: Ein erstes Werkzeug von dir wird von einem Team im Alltag genutzt. Du kennst die Datenstrecken aus DATEV und arbeitest sicher in unserer Entwicklungsumgebung. Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast: Du verantwortest einen eigenen Baustein von der Anforderung bis zum Betrieb. Andere bauen auf deinem Code auf, und deine Pull Requests gehen ohne große Nacharbeit durch. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Du arbeitest wie ein Engineer im Team und nicht wie eine Aushilfe. Der Einstieg nach dem Master ist konkret: als Founding Engineer oder mit verlängerter Werkstudentenzeit bis zum Abschluss. Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt: Werkstudent bei Vogel ist der Weg in den Berufseinstieg als Founding Engineer. Danach wächst du in die Verantwortung für einen eigenen Produktbereich, in der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn oder in der Führungslaufbahn. Der Beitrag entscheidet, nicht das Berufsjahr. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung & Track Record Masterstudium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem verwandten technischen Fach, an der TUM oder einer vergleichbar starken Universität. Du hast schon Software gebaut, die andere benutzt haben: im Studium, in einem Werkstudentenjob oder in einem eigenen Projekt. Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, aber nachweislich gebaut haben, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Bachelorstudierende kurz vor dem Master mit eigenem Projekt, Studierende der Physik oder Mathematik mit Engineering-Spur, Gründer eines kleinen Produkts. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Skills & Arbeitsweise Du schreibst sauberen Code in mindestens einer Sprache, idealerweise Python oder TypeScript, und kennst SQL. Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug, um Code zu schreiben, zu prüfen und zu testen, und weißt, wo sie danebenliegt. Du willst Breite: Daten, Backend, Oberfläche und Agenten, nicht eine einzelne Schicht. Du arbeitest auf Deutsch, weil unsere Berater und Mandanten es tun, und du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Büro. Mindset & Persönlichkeit Du bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen. Der Steuerberater mit 20 Jahren Erfahrung weiß Dinge über seinen Prozess, die in keinem Diagramm stehen. Du verträgst die direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: schnelle Iteration, hohe Eigenständigkeit und manchmal Aufgaben, die nicht im Lebenslauf glänzen. Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört. Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst Keinen Werkstudentenjob, in dem du Tickets abarbeitest, deren Nutzer du nie siehst. Du sitzt mit den Beratern am Fall und baust für sie. Kein Werkstudenten-Setup nach Stundenkontingent ohne Entwicklung. Du wirst über die Zeit messbar besser und trägst mehr. Keine Software-Firma. Wir sind ein Beratungsunternehmen, das seine eigene Software baut. Die Nutzer sind unsere eigenen Teams. Kein Greenfield in einem leeren Raum. DATEV läuft, Mandanten warten nicht. Was du baust, muss neben dem laufenden Betrieb funktionieren. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Where it leads: from engineer to owning a product area, as a senior engineer or by leading a team, decided by contribution, not by years served. You have shipped software that other people used, at work, as a working student or in your own project. Decades of audited, closed work, and advisors who use what you ship the same week. Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build. Close to the decisions. title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice) - m/f/d
description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

Position Overview

The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, working closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practical input to projects. A Senior Associate would typically:

  •  Conduct analyses and collect evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring the use of cloud computing
  •  Build economic models tailored to the issues at hand and supporting our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Contribute to the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers
  •  Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner
  •  Manage and mentor junior staff
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions
  • Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.)

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialisation in industrial economics and/or econometrics; non-PhD applicants should have a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority
  • Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
  • High degree of numeracy, ability to analyse data, familiarity with econometric techniques
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in economic consulting through coursework, work experience, or activities

To Apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Germany and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;
  • Transcripts (optional) - from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: .Net Developer (Remote Opportunity)
description: We are currently looking for a .NET Developer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Data Migration & Syndication (DMS) initiative within the Electronic Health Record Modernization Integration Office (EHRM-IO). The developer will design, develop, test, and maintain secure applications and data integration solutions using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, SQL, REST APIs, and InterSystems IRIS while supporting enterprise data migration, interoperability, and modernization efforts. The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary Agile development team, collaborating with software developers, EHRM architects, database specialists, quality assurance personnel, and federal stakeholders. The developer will participate in software development lifecycle activities, application troubleshooting, production support, and continuous improvement initiatives, including evaluating AI-assisted development tools and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations. The candidate must reside within the continental US. Responsibilities: Design, develop, enhance, and maintain secure applications using C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET, MVC, Web API, JavaScript, Angular, React, and related technologies to support VA healthcare data migration and syndication initiatives. Develop and maintain database-driven applications, data integration processes, and interfaces using SQL, MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, SOAP/REST APIs, and InterSystems IRIS/HealthShare, including secure web services, metadata management, database design, and performance optimization. Collaborate with EHRM architects and cross-functional teams to conduct gap analyses, identify application and data management requirements, develop technical solutions, and implement software enhancements supporting interoperability and change management objectives. Perform application troubleshooting, debugging, root cause analysis, unit testing, integration testing, and performance testing while implementing corrective actions, maintaining secure configurations, and supporting application deployment and monitoring within IIS and other environments. Participate in Agile software development activities, including code reviews, technical documentation, version control, CI/CD processes, and application security validation using GitHub, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Fortify, and related development tools. Evaluate and implement AI-assisted development capabilities and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations to support code generation, automated testing, data mapping, migration workflows, and application enhancements while maintaining security, reliability, and code quality standards. Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or another engineering or technical discipline, or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant software development experience. Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET, MVC, and Web API. Proficiency in SQL, relational database development, database design, query optimization, and integration with databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL. Experience developing and consuming RESTful and SOAP web services, implementing JavaScript-based web applications, and using modern development tools, version control systems, and Agile software development methodologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify software defects, perform root cause analysis, and develop secure, maintainable, and well-documented solutions. Excellent communication, organizational, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a remote, multidisciplinary development environment and coordinate with technical teams and stakeholders. Additional Qualifications: Previous experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal government organizations, particularly healthcare modernization, data migration, data syndication, or interoperability initiatives involving InterSystems IRIS, HealthShare, Caché, or related technologies. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate, refactor, document, and test C#/.NET applications; familiarity with LLM API integrations, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI-assisted SQL or data transformation development. Familiarity with federal application security requirements, PHI/PII protection, responsible AI practices, and development quality controls, including Fortify, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, secure code reviews, and agency-approved AI tools. Security Clearance Requirements: U.S. Citizenship is required. All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check. Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting,   when required for the position. Benefits: Medical/Dental/Vision 401k with Employer Match PTO + Federal Holidays Corporate Laptop Training Opportunities Remote Opportunity VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Sorry, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.
